target: Compile the merged Dopemux agent and persona fleet into a strict, deterministic, model-free, advisory CommandCode catalog without generating agents, activating routing, or granting new authority.
invariants: PR #1175 is merged before any tracked mutation.
Execution starts from a clean dedicated worktree at fresh merged origin/main.
Relevant post-PR1175 drift is absent.
All agent and persona source files remain byte-identical.
The catalog contains exactly nine executable base-agent records.
Every base-agent canonical role resolves through src/dopemux/roles/catalog.py.
Every active persona source is represented exactly once by record or alias group.
No duplicate normalized agent or persona ID exists.
No archived or personal-lane source becomes automatic route authority.
Normalized catalog and schema contain no exact model IDs or model preferences.
Every persona has may_change_tools=false, may_select_model=false, and may_grant_write_authority=false.
general-purpose-dopemux is never an automatic write fallback.
Only architecture-approved personas are route_eligible=true; every other persona is advisory/manual.
Catalog generation is deterministic and builder --check reports no drift.
The catalog validates against a strict additionalProperties=false schema.
No generated CommandCode agent, skill, hook, MCP, DCP, Universal Router, role, or runtime activation is created or changed.
C1 changed paths equal the implementation allowlist.
proof/CCAR-002/PROOF.json records required audit as SKIPPED with a nonempty pending-audit reason.
Fresh independent audit is bound to exact C1 and current PR base.
C2 differs from C1 only under proof/pr_merge/embedded-audit/pr-<actual PR>/**.
Signed proof bytes, committed bytes, and local acceptance agree.
All required CI and PR Steward gates are current and successful.
No merge occurs.

execution.stacked_because: Do not stack on PR #1175. Start only after PR #1175 is merged from fresh origin/main. Preferred route: CommandCode deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro high; fallback xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro. Mandatory audit: AGY gemini-3.1-pro-high.

verify: Require PR #1175 merged and contained in locked origin/main.
Capture repo, branch, worktree, base, dependency PR, runner, agent, model, effort, and route evidence.
Require exact source inventory coverage and source SHA-256 immutability.
Require exactly nine base agents and current runtime role resolution.
Require every active persona represented exactly once by record or alias group.
Require no exact model ID in normalized catalog or schema.
Require every persona authority-prohibition boolean false.
Require catalog schema validation, deterministic regeneration, and builder --check.
Require focused CommandCode-router tests and persona-fleet architecture tests.
Require no generated CommandCode agent, skill, hook, MCP, router, role, or runtime change.
Require C1 paths equal the implementation allowlist and proof/CCAR-002 audit status honestly pending.
Require fresh AGY gemini-3.1-pro-high audit bound to exact C1.
Require signed canonical C2 proof-only delta and local acceptance.
Require all CI and PR Steward gates current and successful.

pr.title: feat(commandcode): normalized agent and persona catalog
pr.body: Add a deterministic, schema-valid shadow catalog over the merged Dopemux agent/persona fleet. Separate roles, executable base agents and advisory personas; exclude model IDs and authority leakage; generate no CommandCode agents and activate no routing. Include fresh implementation proof and independent audit. Do not merge.
